introduction_markdown: You are required to answer FIVE questions, choosing THREE from Section A and TWO from Section B. All the questions carry equal marks and marks allocated to parts of questions are indicated. Extra questions answered from each section shall NOT be marked. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. Duration: two and a half hours.

questions.enonce_markdown: What are the qualities  of a good hospital? *(6 marks)*

State the benefits of the following to the community?

(i) Playgrounds (ii) Religious organisations. *(6, 4 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Playgrounds**:

1. They provide **recreation** and entertainment for the community.
2. They allow **physical exercise**, which keeps people healthy and fit.
3. They help people to **meet and socialise**, which promotes unity and friendship.
4. They help to **discover and develop talents** (sports).
5. They keep young people **busy and away from crime**, drugs and other vices.
6. They help to **relieve stress**, and they can bring income through games and events.

(Any six.)

(ii) **Religious organisations**:

1. They teach **moral values** (honesty, respect, discipline), so they reduce crime.
2. They provide **counselling and comfort** to people in difficulty.
3. They help the poor and sick through **charity** and may build schools and hospitals.
4. They promote **peace and unity** among people.

(Any four.)

questions.enonce_markdown: How is prostitution harmful to the society? *(4 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. It spreads **sexually transmitted infections** such as HIV/AIDS, gonorrhoea and syphilis.
2. It causes **unwanted pregnancies**, unsafe abortions and abandoned children.
3. It leads to **moral decay**, with loss of respect for marriage and family values, and to **broken homes**.
4. It is linked to **crime**, violence, drug abuse and exploitation of young girls.
5. It lowers the **productivity** of the population through illness and early death.

(Any four.)
